title: CollectibleItem.cs
summary: Per-item data and pickup logic for a single collectible: its stable ID, display name, and the 3D model swap-and-refresh pattern shared with NPC.cs.

notes.text: Stable identifier a Quest's collectible requirement matches against — keep this constant even if the display name changes.
FormerlySerializedAs preserves existing scene data after the field was renamed from 'displayName' to 'collectibleName'.

notes.match: [Tooltip("Prefab or imported model displayed for this collectible.")]
notes.text: Whatever visual prefab represents this item in the world (swappable via 'Refresh 3D Model' in the custom Inspector).
How close the player must be to pick this up.
Runtime flag — true once picked up; also exposed in Play mode via the custom Inspector.
Set by CollectiblesManager when it catalogs scene items — not meant to be assigned manually.
Tracks the currently-instantiated visual model so RefreshModel can clean up the old one first.
Falls back to a generic label if no name was set, so the prompt text is never blank.
Finds the scene's CollectiblesManager automatically if this item wasn't explicitly registered.
Ensures a model is instantiated on first load even if RefreshModel was never manually clicked in the Editor.
Public range check other scripts (CollectiblesManager) use to decide if this item is currently reachable.
The actual pickup: guards against double-collection, then routes through the manager (which counts it and plays the shrink-away) or just deactivates itself if there's no manager.
Destroys any previously-spawned model before creating a new one — Destroy in Play mode, DestroyImmediate in the Editor (Destroy is deferred and not allowed outside Play mode).
Legacy items authored as plain primitives (a MeshRenderer directly on this object) keep showing until a real model prefab replaces them.
No model assigned — nothing further to instantiate.

In the Editor outside Play mode, uses PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab so the instance stays linked to its source prefab (so prefab overrides/updates keep working); Instantiate is used everywhere else.
Resets the spawned model's local transform to identity — the prefab's own pivot should already be correct.
Disables every collider on the visual model so only the collectible root's own collider drives interaction — an imported model with its own colliders could otherwise block the player.
